comparison.objective: Lock a floating guide rod at the carriage-set end position, then demonstrate full slide travel with a crank.
comparison.physical_skill: Position-dependent locking followed by physical mechanism actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Carriage runs the full slide length and back without sticking, after which the robot releases it.
comparison.reason: This plausibly overlaps the candidate's lock-adjust-test loop: both set and lock a mechanism, physically cycle it, and judge operation. The available record omits the locking mechanism, manipulation sequence, tolerances, and fault rubric, so it cannot establish whether the candidate's fine captive-screw/collar reacquisition and measured iterative tuning are meaningfully distinct.
